//: Where the onboarding tool is allowed to run create-trip-link. Copy to
~/kinerary-deploy/onboarding-target.json and fill in. Real values never
live in this repo — same rule as fleet-stacks.json and issue-target.json.
'command' is the path to the create-trip-link WRAPPER (not the repo
script) — the wrapper is what supplies the real host, bot, ssh key and
credential store. It is resolved relative to this config file, so '~/'
and a bare relative path both work.
There is nothing else to fill in here: create-trip-link itself refuses
to run if its own env is unset, so this file only has to point at it.
//maxPerHour: A ceiling, not a target. One operator confirming one email at a time
does not approach this in an hour; hitting it means something is
looping, and the tool refuses rather than minting more accounts. Raise
it only when you have seen the rate be real.
